name: Droply Free Static Hosting
free_limit: 1 static site on a droply.id HTTPS subdomain; 25 MB total storage, 5,000 visits/month, 5 GB bandwidth/month, 15 publishes/day.
watch_out: Free sites show Droply branding and are served noindex/nofollow; no custom domain or server-side code. Over-limit sites show a notice until quota resets, without automatic overage billing. Commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.
